LESSON: GUIDED WRITING

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Writing 3.3 Guided Writing (1 lesson) • Mechanics of writing: spelling By the en
Topic 3.4: Guided Writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 1

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Writing, part of Writing 3.3 Guided Writing (1 lesson) • Mechanics of writing: spelling By the en in Grade 7 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: Why is punctuation important?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. write down the dates in the correct format in Chinese (年、月、日),

2. work with peers to list down names of important dates (birth, festivities and holidays) from a dictation (e.g. 圣诞节 shèngdàn jié、情人节 qíngrén jié、新年 xīnnián、劳动节 láodòng jié、独立日 dúlì rì 、自治日 zìzhì rì, etc.),

3. work jointly to write and count numbers correctly,

4. watch a digital calendar and mark the dates of important days with peers,

5. team up to write down holiday greetings for corresponding important days (生日快 乐! Shēngrì kuàilè! 劳动节愉快! Láodòng Jié yúkuài! 新年快乐! Xīnnián kuàilè! etc.),

6. research online or offline on important days in Kenya in China and share their findings,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. write down the dates in the correct format in Chinese (年、月、日),
2. work with peers to list down names of important dates (birth, festivities and holidays) from a dictation (e.g. 圣诞节 shèngdàn jié、情人节 qíngrén jié、新年 xīnnián、劳动节 láodòng jié、独立日 dúlì rì 、自治日 zìzhì rì, etc.),
3. work jointly to write and count numbers correctly,
4. watch a digital calendar and mark the dates of important days with peers,
5. team up to write down holiday greetings for corresponding important days (生日快 乐! Shēngrì kuàilè! 劳动节愉快! Láodòng Jié yúkuài! 新年快乐! Xīnnián kuàilè! etc.),
6. research online or offline on important days in Kenya in China and share their findings,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Citizenship: the learner exhibits pride in their national and cultural identity through awareness of important national days in

the country.

• Digital Literacy: the learner connects to and uses the internet to search for the different important days in Kenya and China.

Values:
Unity: the learner appreciates the efforts of others as they give their feedback on the greeting cards.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Healthy relationships are fostered as the learner collaborates with peers to write down holiday greetings for the important days.

Link to Other Learning Areas:

The learner links their learning to Creative Arts and Sports on the concept of creative presentation of ideas.
